name: Stormbringer: Torrential Wrath cross-talents work natively (#2819, #3087, #3663)
contract: Three passives report 'Spell Script / Aura Handler Not Implemented' but are plain Spell.dbc modifiers on Torrential Wrath (804017, SpellFamilyName 22) and its sibling spells; SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod has no special case for family 22, so the generic mask test at SpellInfo.cpp:1437 applies to all three, and none of the affected spells carries SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS. #2819 Disciple of Thorim (705727/707795/707798, ranks 1-3): eff0 is aura 107 SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME (misc 10), BasePoints -201/-401/-601 + DieSides 1 = -200/-400/-600 ms, class mask word1 0x11 intersecting Torrential Wrath's own SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x1, applied by Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10323) inside Unit::CalcSpellCastTime (Unit.cpp:12317); eff1 is aura 333 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT, BasePoints 1/3/5 + 1 = 2/4/6, a real handled CoA aura (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:398, consumed at StatSystem.cpp:999/1005/1011). Torrential Wrath's CastingTimeIndex is 19 = 2500 ms (SpellCastTimes.dbc). #3087 Raining and Pouring (706660): one aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 15 (SPELLMOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS), BasePoints 29 + 1 = 30, class mask word1 0x200001 = bit0 (Torrential Wrath) + bit21 (Electrocute 801844, SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x200000), applied inside Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus (Unit.cpp:9960); Stormflow (567555) is not in the mask and is asserted as a control. #3663 Torrential Rage (807196 rank1/807884 rank2): eff0 is aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 14/29 + 1 = 15/30, class mask word1 0x1 (Torrential Wrath); eff1 is the same aura type MiscValue 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), same BasePoints, class mask word1 0x10000 (Stormflow's own SpellFamilyFlags[1] 0x10000, Stormflow deals its damage through SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE so damagetype == DOT selects SPELLMOD_DOT at Unit.cpp:9369); cross-controls (op 22 on 804017, op 0 on 567555) confirm each effect's mask lands on only its own spell. Percentage DAMAGE/DOT mods are multiplicative (Player.cpp:10273, base 1000 -> 1150 -> 1300), CASTING_TIME is (base + flat) * mul (Player.cpp:10323), CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS is additive (Player.cpp:10275, base 1000 -> 1300). Every rank is unlearned before the next is learned so ranks never stack, which the talent tree never allows either. All expected numbers come from Spell.dbc EffectBasePoints/DieSides and SpellCastTimes id 19; none is invented.
